quote: Customer funding receivable represents amounts due from our customer for construction related payables and accrued expenses incurred on their behalf. The Company collects these amounts from the customer prior to payment to vendors.
issuer_treatment: H1 2025 : créance de financement construction client 230,672 M adossée à dettes fournisseurs 150,1 M et accrual 80,6 M. La société indique collecter AVANT de payer ses fournisseurs : mécanisme de financement/relais documenté, mais créance au bilan non assimilée à cash déjà reçu. Ne pas sommer créance, obligations financées et total engagements.
